shortDescription: Information module for Endpoint Analytics Profiling-Rules

options.name: catalystcenter_debug
options.description: Flag for Cisco Catalyst Center SDK to enable debugging.

options.name: catalystcenter_password
options.description: The Cisco Catalyst Center password to authenticate.

options.name: catalystcenter_username
options.description: The Cisco Catalyst Center username to authenticate.

options.name: catalystcenter_verify
options.description: Flag to enable or disable SSL certificate verification.

options.name: catalystcenter_version
options.description: Informs the SDK which version of Cisco Catalyst Center to use.

options.name: includeDeleted
options.description: IncludeDeleted query parameter. Flag to indicate whether deleted rules should be part of the records fetched.

options.name: limit
options.description: Limit query parameter. Maximum number of records to be fetched. If not provided, 500 records will be fetched by default. To fetch all the records in the system, provide a large value for this parameter.

options.name: offset
options.description: Offset query parameter. Record offset to start data fetch at. Offset starts at zero.

options.name: order
options.description: Order query parameter. Order to be used for sorting.

options.name: ruleId
options.description: RuleId path parameter. Unique rule identifier.

options.name: ruleType
options.description: RuleType query parameter. Use comma-separated list of rule types to filter the data. Defaults to 'Custom Rule'.

options.name: sortBy
options.description: SortBy query parameter. Name of the column to sort the results on. Please note that fetch might take more time if sorting is requested.

options.name: validate_response_schema
options.description: Flag for Cisco Catalyst Center SDK to enable the validation of request bodies against a JSON schema.
